slides.title: Pointer to Constant Data
options: The integer value pointed to cannot be modified through 'ptr'
The pointer itself cannot point to a different address
Both the pointer address and integer value are constant
The memory is allocated on constant read-only RAM
slides.correctAnswer: The integer value pointed to cannot be modified through 'ptr'
